scope: The F3 captured-tape capture hierarchy follow-on and the P7 verification half: (1) a default-deny CapturedReplayTape.v1 codec owned by dskit/production/bundles.py; (2) three generic capture collaborators reusing trust.py's opaque F4 capture/lifecycle primitives; (3) the composed-tape verification seam that resolves the two P7 tape_manifest/tape_data descriptors to verified PUBLISHED/CAPTURED identities and issues the only opaque capability that may become a runtime ReplayTape.
non_goals: R1-R5 replay transaction machinery (AtomicJournalReplace, AtomicSeriesStateReplace, FrozenReplayPlan.v2, lease/idempotency journal)
F1/F2 EventEnvelope causal reordering or the full feed/roster data-capture lane beyond P7 verification
deriving ordered_envelope_digests from a real feed (digests are supplied inputs; the codec verifies internal consistency only)
a runtime ReplayTape with start_ms/feed_results/id_allocations (that is R1)
second planner, ledger, or tape engine
real data, replay execution, training, HPO/refit, backtest, paper/live, deployment

location_and_purity.codec_and_verification: dskit/production/bundles.py owns the CapturedReplayTape.v1 parser/canonical bytes and its private composed-tape verification seam (plan line 542-543).
location_and_purity.collaborators: ReplayTapeDataCapture / ReplayTapeManifestProducer / ReplayTapeManifestCapture live in dskit/production/bundles.py as opaque collaborators reusing trust.py public seams (VerifiedCapture, CapturedMemberHandle, CapturedLifecyclePort, CapturedBindings, LifecycleAuthority).
location_and_purity.rationale: pipeline (trust.py) must never import production; production may import pipeline. The composed-tape verification needs the v1 schema, so it must sit on the production side. The ReplayRun NODE stays in pipeline/trust.py (grammar seam, done in slice 1); the composed-tape BROKER is production-side.
location_and_purity.new_trust_seam: One small read-only, nonauthorizing accessor is added to trust.py to expose the retained CAPTURED receipt digest for a captured publication (the inner manifest's data_captured_receipt must be verified against the ACTUAL manifest-producer CAPTURED receipt). It refuses unless the stream is already CAPTURED. This is the only trust.py change and it grants no member access or lifecycle transition.

fields.name: ordered_envelope_digests
fields.rule: list of lowercase sha256, length == envelope_count

fields.name: tape_digest
fields.rule: lowercase sha256; recomputed = sha256(canonical(object with tape_digest omitted))

codec_contract.canonicalization: sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII, NaN refused (the repo pinned recipe; the codec reuses production's canonical recipe and a test pins agreement with trust's digest where relevant).
codec_contract.construction: No public constructor. A private factory builds from the seven inputs (schema/field literals are fixed) and computes ordered_envelopes_sha256 and tape_digest. parse(raw_bytes) is the default-deny read side.
codec_contract.parse_refusals: unknown/extra/missing field; wrong type; non-lowercase or non-64-hex sha256; envelope_count != len(ordered_envelope_digests); envelope_count != 0 but empty digests (and the converse); recomputed ordered_envelopes_sha256 mismatch; recomputed tape_digest mismatch; non-canonical bytes (NaN, non-ASCII, non-JSON).

capture_hierarchy.ReplayTapeDataCapture: opaque collaborator binding the parent data WORM capture (raw_event_dataset + source_roster members) whose root is PUBLISHED; exposes the verified outer data PUBLISH identity and retained members.
capture_hierarchy.ReplayTapeManifestProducer: opaque collaborator for the distinct later consumer that derives the inner CapturedReplayTape.v1 bytes from the consumed data capture and PUBLISHES them in its own manifest root/receipt; binds the prior parent CAPTURED receipt.
capture_hierarchy.ReplayTapeManifestCapture: opaque collaborator binding the manifest producer's own PUBLISH root/receipt (the outer manifest identity).
capture_hierarchy.composed_tape: ComposedReplayTape is an opaque capability issued only after the verification below; it is the only object that may become a runtime ReplayTape. Same run/session consumption and raw legacy ReplayTape admission refuse.

verification_seam.name: compose_replay_tape (private verification seam in bundles.py)
steps: 1. Resolve the tape_manifest descriptor to the outer manifest PUBLISHED root and open its VerifiedCapture; read the inner CapturedReplayTape.v1 bytes from the manifest member.
2. Parse the inner bytes with the default-deny codec (codec_contract.parse_refusals all apply).
3. Verify inner data_capture_root equals the data PUBLISH root identity; verify inner data_captured_receipt equals the retained manifest-producer CAPTURED receipt for that data root.
4. Verify inner source_rank_policy_sha256 against the consumed roster/policy evidence (synthetic fixture pin; never derived from a resulting tape).
5. Verify the separate replay-data CAPTURED receipt against the replay data port (the tape_data descriptor resolves to the same data PUBLISH root).
6. Only after 1-5 pass, issue the opaque ComposedReplayTape capability.
verification_seam.forbidden: swapped parent/manifest receipts, same-root/self-receipt, outer-capture substitution, parent mutation/reorder, policy/root/receipt substitution, reordered digest list, missing hierarchy, same-run/session, raw legacy ReplayTape admission.

positive_grammar: Two descriptors resolve through the exact chronology: data PUBLISH -> manifest-producer CAPTURE (parent receipt) -> manifest PUBLISH -> replay CAPTURE (manifest + data) -> composed tape. The inner manifest's eight/fixed fields recompute exactly.

cases: manifest root recorded inside its own inner bytes
data_captured_receipt does not equal retained CAPTURED receipt
data_capture_root does not equal data PUBLISH identity

compatibility.p4_p6: ReplayRun owned-kind pair grammar and P4/P6 capture machinery unchanged; the new seam reuses authorize_capture_set / capture / open_capture / captured_bindings, no second engine.
compatibility.purity: pipeline (trust.py) never imports production; the new accessor in trust.py is stdlib-only and nonauthorizing; bundles.py imports only dskit.pipeline public names + base.
compatibility.ordinary_docs: no PipelineDocument/parser/planner change in this slice.

forbidden_effects: composed tape before all five verification steps
a second ledger, tape engine, or planner
minting authority from the codec or collaborators

tests.new: tests/production/test_captured_replay_tape.py: codec positive build/parse/canonical; codec-shape + codec-digest negative families; hierarchy + receipt + policy + capability negative families; synthetic F4 fixtures build data PUBLISH -> manifest producer CAPTURE -> manifest PUBLISH -> replay CAPTURE -> composed tape positive flow.
tests.census: production oop/producers/purity gates must stay green (bundles.py gains public names; no new closed-set vocabulary unless in vocab.py).
